facts.text: Orbit Electronics' transaction GMV for 12–18 October 2026 was ₹5,085,470.47, against settled gross of ₹5,074,271.13.
Refunds of ₹65,213.40 and fees (MDR) of ₹36,783.23 were netted off, leaving settled net of ₹4,972,274.50.
After accounting for refunds and fees, an unexplained difference of -₹11,199.34 (-0.22%) remains between settled gross and the GMV of the dates covered.
The whole unexplained difference sits in one batch, STL-MER0397-20261014, for 14 October: gross ₹610,986.45 versus GMV ₹622,185.79 (-1.80%).
The data-quality scan found 341 duplicate attempts on 12 October (11,704 raw rows vs 11,363 unique attempts); these were removed so each attempt is counted once.

response.headline: Mostly, but not fully: Orbit Electronics' settlements fall ₹11,199.34 (0.22%) short of its transactions for 12–18 October, and the shortfall is not explained by refunds or fees. It traces to one batch on 14 October, which is flagged for investigation.
